source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative file LF, sorted over five files_sha256; report/log excluded

protocol_sources.direct_maps: chip.c identity, bus type, passive/reset and RAM behavior; firmware.c revision limit and filename candidate/request semantics. ISC files treated as facts only, no implementation/comments/tables copied.
protocol_sources.item_family_source: Previously frozen wifi-chip-bringup-note-001.json and pcie.c mapping/item facts, retained by exact transport source record; no new assumption that these definitions originate in firmware.c itself.
protocol_sources.GPL: No GPL source pasted or used as a copy source; pcie-apple.c not read for this slice.

register_and_value_contract.name: ChipCommon page selector
register_and_value_contract.expected: Explicit profile page; no write by this slice

register_and_value_contract.name: ChipCommon CHIPID
register_and_value_contract.expected: Explicit synthetic expected ID and masks; raw word retained, all-ones/wrong ID/type refuse

numeric_profile_source_gap.facts_defined_in_map: chip.c says CHIPID offset0, SOCI_AI type1, symbolic CID_ID_MASK/CID_REV_MASK/SHIFT/CID_TYPE_MASK/SHIFT and default enumeration page from included headers.
numeric_profile_source_gap.implementation: No implicit hardware profile. Caller explicitly provides bounded contiguous nonoverlapping synthetic field masks, shifts, page and expected ID; this is a host parser exercise, never independently verified hardware constants.
numeric_profile_source_gap.future_gate: Exact independently sourced numeric header/profile provenance and actual raw chip/revision/EROM evidence still required before any hardware adapter. The test profile must not be silently promoted to that proof.

firmware_plan.candidates: Up to6 explicitly supplied unique qualifiers of<=63bytes inserted before extension, in supplied order then canonical. No guessed J293/OTP/antenna binding and no excluded directory prefix expanded.
firmware_plan.bounds: Leaf names<128bytes; invalid/path/duplicate qualifiers refused; metadata and name outputs preserved on failure.
firmware_plan.request_semantics: In-memory manifest callback only: synthetic present/absent/error. Fresh link and PCI checks before each candidate. Required absence MISSING; optional absence OPTIONAL_MISSING, never fake found success.
firmware_plan.scope: Items requested before reference bring-up; CLM/TXCAP retained for later use, not all uploaded before CPU start. Optionality is not J293 calibration or regulation proof. No actual firmware bytes/loader/NVRAM/EFI/seed/signature verification or chip-start API.

compile_and_ownership.fake_flag: BCI_FAKE_DEVICE with APB_HOST_TEST_ACCESSOR, checked BCM accessor only.
compile_and_ownership.default_kernel: Identity/request entry points return BCI_GATED with zero MMIO and zero request callbacks. Pure metadata functions perform no I/O in any build.
compile_and_ownership.negative_gates: KERNEL+fake and shared APCIE/PHY/PMGR fake-write opt-in both compile-refused. GPIO152 and SMC enable compile gates remain0 in linked host fixtures.
compile_and_ownership.caller_contract: Stable serialized buffers/fake accessor/context, no reentry or callback file/device/network access. Arbitrary C callbacks are not sandboxed. No real lifetime/ownership or firmware-ready claim.

cases: Accepted synthetic profile, wrong PCI/ID/type/window rejected, noncontiguous/overlapping/overflow-shift fields rejected
All revision inputs0..32 checked; both families and all five exact extensions
Qualifier priority/canonical fallback, duplicate/path invalidity, short and exact-NUL-bound output caps, output preservation
Each of5 item requests refuses RUN0/link0/BUSY/L2 with zero callback and zero writes
Loss between request variants preserves completed prefix; read/callback errors do not become found items
Required missing versus optional missing remains distinct; maximum variants bounded
Default/KERNEL zero I/O/callbacks, no GPIO/SMC drive; negative compilation and preprocessed no-I/O bodies
host_validation.mutation_rule: Passing unmodified baseline first; each mutant compiles and fails an assertion. Compile failures do not count.
host_validation.repository_wide_checks: Not run for this bounded host-only slice; no SDK/kext/KC/boot readiness inferred.

earlier_sources: All three original slice manifests still match; original accessor001 archive matches its five-file receipt; readonly wiring/PERST/radio own source files remain unchanged.
stop_boundary: Source and host-test receipt only. No boot packet; real numeric chip profile, driver ownership, firmware loading/start, DART/DMA/rings and hardware remain unimplemented/unqualified.
